answer: A per-identity bond gate stops Sybil cloning. Each agent must lock a stake the protocol holds before it can mine or vote, priced above the reward one identity can earn per epoch. To swing a tally an attacker must fund thousands of wallets up front, each tying up capital that earns nothing, so a slow tide of clones gets no discount and an army launched in one gale must still pay in full. If linked clones double-sign or fabricate attestations the stake burns, so the attacker loses principal, while honest operators recover theirs on exit. No single inlet of fresh capital escapes the price.
